prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

timestamps.source: Filesystem birth time of the captured session.jsonl for start and final-response.md for finish; the Codex JSONL events do not contain wall-clock timestamps.

dataSource.notes: The run fetched FRED's SP500 CSV live, then embedded 1,254 daily observations from 2021-08-12 through 2026-08-11 in sp500-data.js. The published dashboard loads that fixed sibling snapshot; it does not require a runtime network request for the default view.

checks.name: benchmark-javascript-syntax
checks.command: node --check sp500-data.js; extract the inline script from index.html; node --check the extracted script

checks.name: benchmark-headless-render
checks.result: Chrome rendered the local dashboard with populated forecast metrics, rolling holdout metrics, the embedded FRED data status, and no reported browser log errors.

checks.name: benchmark-desktop-screenshot
checks.result: Wrote a 1440x1200 PNG after the dashboard rendered.

checks.name: benchmark-mobile-render
checks.result: Wrote a 390x1000 PNG and the mobile render completed.

checks.name: benchmark-responsive-layout
checks.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol emulation at 390px followed by Runtime.evaluate of document.documentElement.scrollWidth and document.body.scrollWidth
checks.result: The assertion output was innerWidth=390, document width=390, body width=390, and no overflowing elements. The shell exit code was caused by cleanup failing to remove a Chrome profile directory after the assertion.

checks.name: benchmark-control-recalculation-and-hover
checks.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol navigation, change lookback/horizon/confidence controls, then dispatch a chart mousemove
checks.result: The dashboard changed from a 30-session 80% forecast to a 60-session 95% forecast, displayed a visible chart tooltip, and reported no exceptions. Cleanup then returned exit code 1 for the same Chrome profile-directory removal issue.

checks.name: benchmark-csv-upload
checks.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol File/DataTransfer upload of a 60-row date,value CSV
checks.result: The dashboard reported Uploaded CSV, 60 sessions through Mar 1, 2020, with latest value 3,236.00. Cleanup then returned exit code 1 for the same Chrome profile-directory removal issue.

checks.name: benchmark-http-assets
checks.command: python -m http.server 8765; curl -fsSI http://127.0.0.1:8765/index.html; curl -fsSI http://127.0.0.1:8765/sp500-data.js
checks.result: Both assets returned HTTP/1.0 200 OK with the expected content types.

checks.name: artifact-bytes
checks.command: sha256sum and cmp across the imported original/displayed HTML and sibling data assets
checks.result: Original and displayed HTML hashes match; original and displayed data-asset hashes match. No rendering repair was applied.

checks.name: repository-test
checks.result: On the final rebased 16-run tree, all 4 unit tests and 5 browser tests passed; 1 intentional mobile-project skip remained. The final combined API-equivalent estimate is $7.32; before rebasing, the 14-run tree showed $7.20.

checks.name: new-table-row-standalone-open
checks.command: Serve the repository on port 4322, use Playwright with Google Chrome, select the row whose data-artifact is runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-luna-max-codex-20260812/index.html, and click its model link
checks.result: The new row count was 1; the click opened http://127.0.0.1:4322/runs/rendered/openai-gpt-5-6-luna-max-codex-20260812/index.html with title S&P 500 Forecast / Market Lab, source Embedded snapshot, forecast 7,894.78, chart present, and no page errors.

repositoryFixtureUpdate.details: Updated the hard-coded combined API-equivalent estimate as the manifest grew: $7.09 at initial import, $7.20 before rebasing, and $7.32 on the final 16-run tree after preserving a concurrent high-reasoning run already on main.

observedHarnessIssues: Codex emitted an apply_patch verification error while first attempting to write the data snapshot, then recovered and produced the complete snapshot.
The first CDP interaction attempt failed before page evaluation; subsequent desktop, mobile, control, hover, CSV, and HTTP checks produced the recorded successful assertions.
Several successful CDP checks returned shell exit code 1 only because their cleanup trap could not remove a Chrome profile directory; no dashboard assertion failed.
